stage3_logistics.decision_summary: EXPORT DECISION: Export Wheat from Hazira Port (INHZA, Gujarat) to Mongla Port (BDMON, Bangladesh). Plan on 20FT containers. Move cargo inland by Rail from Ludhiana (1417.9 km). Estimated logistics $96.18 (~INR 8,031)/ton (~$2,692.96 (~INR 224,862)/container), transit ~8.3 days via Direct service.
action_plan: 1. Procure Wheat near Ludhiana, Punjab (volume follows allocated containers).
2. Book inland rail haul to Hazira Port (INHZA).
3. Reserve allocated 20FT containers and complete export documentation / customs at Indian port.
4. Book ocean freight INHZA → BDMON (Direct, ~5.0 sea days).
5. Clear cargo at Mongla Port, Bangladesh.
stage3_logistics.purchase_guidance: Buy Wheat in India near Ludhiana, Punjab at predicted ~INR 2,971/quintal for 2026-08.
